translated_title: Peña Nieto Filmed Next to Controversial Israeli Contractor
original_title: Graban a Peña Nieto junto a polémico contratista israelí
author: Mariana Álvarez Torres
meta_description: Former president Enrique Peña Nieto was filmed at an Israeli singer's wedding in Italy seated beside Avishai Neriah, the businessman an Israeli outlet accused of channeling 25 million dollars to him for Mexican government contracts, including Pegasus.
image_warnings: Featured is a video screenshot (1200x633) credited 'Screenshot from the video'; native resolution, low but it is the actual footage.
